_comment: Curated 'core metro' bounding boxes [W,S,E,N] for large metros where a radius box around downtown misses the outer boroughs/airports. add_city uses these automatically (by slug) when no --bbox is given, and treats them as vetted (skips the area/graph-size guardrails). Small cities not listed here keep the default radius box. Boxes aim to cover the populated core + major airports, not far suburbs.
